title: Generated documentation collects HTTP response data without executing it
intent: Synthetic regression for mockhttp-style generated release notes. Command substitution assigns a JSON response field; backticks collect data and process substitution compares responses. Generated JSON, HTML, text, and an inert JavaScript template must not turn retrieval into download-and-execute capability evidence. All samples are inert FileRecord strings.
